0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: The dawn's light will shine again...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: So long as we have these specious accusations hanging over us, we will struggle to achieve anything.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000030_ALPHINAUD
2.description: You must go to Ishgard, as Tataru proposed. I will return to Ul'dah and set things right.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000040_HAURCHEFANT
3.description: Pray do not be so hasty, Master Alphinaud.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000060_HAURCHEFANT
5.description: Full well do I understand your desire to clear your names.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000070_HAURCHEFANT
6.description: But now is not the time for drastic action. You yet have allies upon whom you can rely. There is no need to act alone.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: Yes...yes, of course. Pray forgive my impatience.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000090_HAURCHEFANT
8.description: I bring tidings. Count Edmont has decreed that the three of you be taken in as wards of House Fortemps. Under our patronage, you shall be granted access to the city proper.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000100_HAURCHEFANT
9.description: Pray consider our manor your new headquarters, from which you may gather information and plan how best to proceed.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000110_HAURCHEFANT
10.description: Needless to say, should any of your missing allies be found─as I am certain they shall─they will of course be welcome to join you there.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: You are more than generous, my friend. On behalf of my fellows, I humbly accept your offer of hospitality.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000130_HAURCHEFANT
12.description: The count is a good man and just. He will treat you with the kindness and respect that a hero─and dear friend─deserves.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_000150_ALPHINAUD
14.description: There we shall carry on the Scions' legacy. There we shall begin anew.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_100010_EDMONT
16.description: And so they came, at a friend's behest.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_100020_EDMONT
17.description: Heroes once celebrated as saviors of Eorzea, brought low through treachery,<hex:02100103>their names blackened with royal blood...

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_100030_EDMONT
18.description: With memories of the lost and dreams of redemption,<hex:02100103>with hope yet in their hearts, they came...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200010_EDMONT
19.description: To Ishgard, shining city on the mount, overlooking the dominion of Coerthas...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200020_EDMONT
20.description: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury, ruled by Thordan VII,<hex:02100103>Archbishop of the Ishgardian Orthodox Church...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200030_EDMONT
21.description: The last bastion of the Faith, her walls ever bristling with<hex:02100103>the sworn swords and spears of her four High Houses...

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200040_EDMONT
22.description: A land that after a thousand years of war<hex:02100103>had forgotten what it was to be at peace.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200050_EDMONT
23.description: Through gates long closed the Warrior of Light and <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> companions passed,<hex:02100103>entering at last a city whose history was written in blood.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200060_EDMONT
24.description: In the midst of the Dragonsong War they came─three weary travelers<hex:02100103>whose arrival would set in motion great change...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200070_EDMONT
25.description: Though none knew then how great...

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_200080_NARRATION
26.description: From the memoirs of Count Edmont de Fortemps<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Heavensward<hex:021A020103>

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300010_HAURCHEFANT
27.description: My lord, I have returned with the Scions.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300020_EDMONT
28.description: I hope your journey was not too taxing.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300030_EDMONT
29.description: I, Count Edmont de Fortemps, do bid you welcome.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300040_EDMONT
30.description: As wards of House Fortemps, you shall be afforded every courtesy. My home is your home.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300050_ALPHINAUD
31.description: My companions and I are deeply honored, Count Fortemps.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300060_EDMONT
32.description: The honor is mine, Master Alphinaud. Consider it an expression of our gratitude for your service to Ishgard.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300070_ALPHINAUD
33.description: Forgive me, my lord, but...are you not concerned? To accept foreign guests at such a juncture─especially ones with our...reputation...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300080_EDMONT
34.description: Do not worry yourself on my account. 'Tis true that Ishgard's first thought has ever been the war effort, hence the closing of our borders...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300090_EDMONT
35.description: ...Yet it is in troubled times most of all that men should seek allies, don't you think?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300100_EDMONT
36.description: Granted, my decision will have raised eyebrows in the Vault and in the halls of the other High Houses.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300110_EDMONT
37.description: But so long as you continue with your altruistic endeavors, I doubt my honored peers will feel moved to voice their concerns.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300120_ALPHINAUD
38.description: Then there is naught to fear. Though our numbers are much reduced, we are no less determined to carry on our work.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300130_EDMONT
39.description: Full glad am I to hear it. Ah, but before you return to your labors, why not take a tour of the city?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_300140_EDMONT
40.description: You would do well, I think, to acquaint yourselves with your new surroundings. After all, you may be here for some time.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_400010_EDMONT
41.description: To the frozen wastes of the western highlands,<hex:02100103>once verdant tracts made pallid by the Calamity...

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_400020_EDMONT
42.description: Beyond the towering wall of ice, to lands long forsaken<hex:02100103>that the knights of Ishgard strove tirelessly to reclaim...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_400030_EDMONT
43.description: To the hamlet of Falcon's Nest, once abandoned,<hex:02100103>now freed of its pall of snow and ash, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> came...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500020_MIDGARDSORMR
45.description: Ahhh, the child who glimpsed the truth.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500040_MIDGARDSORMR
47.description: <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> cameth unto me, as didst thou.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500050_MIDGARDSORMR
48.description: Alike in gifts, yet set upon different paths.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500060_ICEHEART
49.description: (-Iceheart-)He speaks true, Warrior of Light. Like you, I have been blessed with the Echo.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500070_ICEHEART
50.description: (-Iceheart-)The visions terrified me at first. They came without warning. I wondered what I had done to deserve them...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500080_ICEHEART
51.description: (-Iceheart-)But I had no time to ponder such things once the Calamity came.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500090_ICEHEART
52.description: (-Iceheart-)The land turned against us, and in a matter of hours, Falcon's Nest was buried under ten fulms of ice and snow. We had no choice but to flee for Ishgard.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500100_ICEHEART
53.description: (-Iceheart-)We came to the wall, and while we searched for a way through, there was an avalanche. And then I was alone.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500110_ICEHEART
54.description: (-Iceheart-)So I set forth for Dravania. I knew full well what might happen were I found, but I could not survive on my own.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500120_ICEHEART
55.description: (-Iceheart-)I was found, of course─and not by a mere dragon, but by the great wyrm Hraesvelgr!

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500130_ICEHEART
56.description: (-Iceheart-)And it was then that I knew why I had been given this gift, for with it I heard his voice, and saw the truth through his eyes!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500140_ICEHEART
57.description: (-Iceheart-)I was chosen to deliver this revelation to the people─to bring dragon and man together, as they once were, and should ever be!

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A1_000_001
59.description: Killing civilians won't bring them together!

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A1_000_002
60.description: What of the innocents who died when you attacked Foundation?

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500150_ICEHEART
61.description: (-Iceheart-)It wasn't supposed to be like that! You have to believe me! It was...beyond my control...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500160_ICEHEART
62.description: (-Iceheart-)Children taught to fear the skies, who saw their loved ones slaughtered...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500170_ICEHEART
63.description: (-Iceheart-)Yet the Dravanians─though they know where the fault truly lies─fell upon them with such fury...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500180_MIDGARDSORMR
64.description: Men die, and their children forget. But we are everlasting. To us, then is as now.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500190_MIDGARDSORMR
65.description: Thou canst not comprehend the violation. The outrage. The fury.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500210_ICEHEART
67.description: (-Iceheart-)I am neither a saint nor a savior─just another sinner. Yet I will not forsake this cause. I cannot. I will see this cycle broken and peace restored.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_500220_ICEHEART
68.description: (-Iceheart-)I... We can do naught else, for we are now as one...

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_600010_EDMONT
69.description: Upon an airship conceived within the fecund mind of Cid Garlond,<hex:02100103>renegade prodigy of Garlemald who had come to call Eorzea home...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_600020_EDMONT
70.description: High into the heavens where isles of earth and stone floated as clouds─<hex:02100103>a frontier the knights of Ishgard had scarce begun to explore...

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_600030_EDMONT
71.description: To a fledgling outpost within the Sea of Clouds where careworn scouts<hex:02100103>ever scanned the skies for winged shadows, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> came...

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_700020_HONU
73.description: Anger of Honu, chief of mighty Vundu, roils like blackest storm clouds!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_700030_HONU
74.description: Offer netherlings to the White! Cloud sea swells and He comes!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_700040_HONU
75.description: The White! The White! Mighty Bismarck, Lord of the Mists!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_700050_HAURCHEFANT
76.description: A flying whale!? By the Fury, i-it's a primal!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_700080_CID
79.description: Bloody typical... All right─we're going in!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800010_EDMONT
82.description: The hero returns! I cannot thank you enough for saving young Emmanellain's life. Aye, aye─he told me everything.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800020_EDMONT
83.description: I've also received letters from both House Dzemael and Durendaire praising your conduct─and that of House Fortemps. You've won us much honor, my friend.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800050_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWARD
86.description: Pray forgive the intrusion, my lord, but I-I bring grave tidings!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800060_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWARD
87.description: Master Alphinaud and Mistress Tataru have been detained on suspicion of fomenting heresy!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800080_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWARD
89.description: They...they were observed entering a tavern in the lower levels on some half-dozen occasions. There, it is claimed, they made a number of inquiries...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800090_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWARD
90.description: Inquiries which brought them into contact with certain...ahem...elements. 'Twas this which prompted a knight of the Heavens' Ward to demand that they be questioned. Ser Grinnaux, my lord...

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800100_EDMONT
91.description: Ser Grinnaux is a brute─an exceedingly accomplished brute, but a brute nonetheless. Alas, he is also a son of House Dzemael.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_800110_EDMONT
92.description: How quickly we forget the petty nature of men. I'd wager your friends are no more than pawns in another of my countrymen's games. Such is the way of things between the High Houses...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900010_TRIALOFFICIANT
93.description: We are gathered here today, under the watchful gaze of the Fury, to ascertain the guilt of two souls in a trial by combat! Petitioners, step forward!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900020_TRIALOFFICIANT
94.description: Ser Grinnaux─for the benefit of all here present, I would ask you to repeat the charges which you have leveled against this man and this woman.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900030_GRINNAUX
95.description: I, Ser Grinnaux de Dzemael, brother of the Heavens' Ward, did bear witness to these two foreigners consorting with heretics!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900050_TRIALOFFICIANT
97.description: Alphinaud Leveilleur, Tataru Taru─you have heard the charges leveled against you.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900060_TRIALOFFICIANT
98.description: Will you take up arms to refute Ser Grinnaux's claim and thereby prove your innocence in the eyes of gods and men?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900070_ALPHINAUD
99.description: I, Alphinaud Leveilleur, am innocent of this charge, and claim my right to trial by combat!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900080_TATARU
100.description: I, Tataru Taru, am innocent of this charge...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900090_TATARU
101.description: But I am no warrior, and cannot fight, so I claim the right to name a champion!

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900100_TRIALOFFICIANT
102.description: To the old and the infirm, the young and the weak, this right we allow. Very well. Who will stand for this woman?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900110_ALPHINAUD
103.description: Just as I was beginning to doubt the efficacy of the Ishgardian justice system! Come, my friend─let us put an end to this mummer's farce!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_900120_TRIALOFFICIANT
104.description: O Halone, render unto us Your judgment! Raise up the righteous, and cast down the wicked!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00010_AYMERIC
105.description: Your Eminence, it is my honor to present to you the Warrior of Light.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00020_THORDAN
106.description: I have heard the tales of your many grand endeavors. The lord commander has also been most effusive in his praise.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00030_THORDAN
107.description: I am Thordan VII, Archbishop of the Ishgardian Orthodox Church, and I bade you come here that I might offer my personal apologies.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00040_THORDAN
108.description: You will forgive me for not calling upon you as courtesy would dictate, but as you can see, my more sprightly days are long behind me. But I digress.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00050_THORDAN
109.description: Your companions were wrongly accused of heresy and subjected to gross indignities. This, I am sorry to say, was the result of negligence on the part of our nation's protectors─negligence born of an excess of zeal. Is that not so, Ser Zephirin?

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00060_ZEPHIRIN
110.description: Yes, Your Eminence... Regrettably, it would appear that we of the Heavens' Ward were in receipt of erroneous information.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00070_ZEPHIRIN
111.description: Ser Grinnaux has ever been headstrong. He pressed charges before the truth had been ascertained, for which I most sincerely apologize.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00080_THORDAN
112.description: An unfortunate misunderstanding born of an earnest desire to serve Ishgard─but one which should never have occurred...

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00090_THORDAN
113.description: For who could doubt the character of those who bested Shiva and drove the Horde from the Steps of Faith? Not I, that much is certain.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00100_THORDAN
114.description: That will be all, Ser Zephirin. I would speak with our guest in private.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00120_ZEPHIRIN
116.description: As you wish, Your Eminence. That will be all for today!

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00130_THORDAN
117.description: Privacy is a luxury rarely afforded one in my position.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00140_THORDAN
118.description: Now, tell me, young <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF046D616E03>: what do you know of the Ascians?

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00150_THORDAN
119.description: Much and more, I shouldn't wonder, being the Bringer of Light. You should know that I myself have met with them─have entertained them as guests, even.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00160_THORDAN
120.description: Those harbingers of chaos and strife offered us power, that we might continue our war against the dragons.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00170_THORDAN
121.description: I have no intention of aiding their cause, of course, nor less of being their puppet.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00180_THORDAN
122.description: Yet were I to refuse them outright, I should learn naught of their true objectives and remain powerless to stop them.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00190_THORDAN
123.description: Thus have I hearkened to their words with interest, and paid lip service to their beliefs, biding my time and preparing for the inevitable conflict.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00200_THORDAN
124.description: And why do I tell you this? Because there is naught in this world they fear more than the power of the Warrior of Light.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_A00210_THORDAN
125.description: If we are to rid ourselves of these vile interlopers, we must needs work together. With our combined strength, I have faith that we can wrest Eorzea from their grasp, and pave the way for a lasting peace. Think on it.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00010_ALPHINAUD
126.description: There you are. I confess, I was more than a little concerned when I learned that you had been summoned to the Vault. What did they want with you?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00020_ALPHINAUD
127.description: Well, well. A formal apology and an admonishment of those responsible? I see my fears were wholly misplaced.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00030_ALPHINAUD
128.description: By the gods, the archbishop freely admits to consorting with Ascians? So their ambitions extend to Ishgard as well...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00040_ALPHINAUD
129.description: We will have new primals to contend with ere long, of that you may be certain. 'Tis but a matter of time. Yet shorn of the support of our missing allies, what can we realistically hope to achieve?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00050_TATARU
130.description: Ahhh! In the midst of all the excitement, I completely forgot to tell you!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00060_TATARU
131.description: When I was asking around about the Scions, I heard the most awful rumor!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00070_TATARU
132.description: General Raubahn is to be executed for crimes against the sultanate!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00080_ALPHINAUD
133.description: If the Flame General dies, we will lose a staunch ally, and the one man capable of holding the sultana's assassins to account.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00090_ALPHINAUD
134.description: Lord Haurchefant was wise to counsel restraint, but this business will brook no delay.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03001_B00100_ALPHINAUD
135.description: We cannot permit this execution to take place. We must save Raubahn!
